Read a whole file and read it line by line.

Supplied answer
with open("data.txt", "r") as f:
    print(f.read()) # whole file as one string
with open("data.txt", "r") as f:
    for line in f: # memory friendly for big files
        print(line.strip())
with open("data.txt", "r") as f:
    lines = f.readlines() # list of lines
print(len(lines), "lines")
Note: Reading line by line is better for large files than read() which loads everything.
